attempts.text:
**The window starts on a single persistent gene.** Column 0 is `otsB`, a spine column: carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls, named in 99.8% of calls at 0.11 bits. Then the graph opens into 79 fork and variable columns.

**The first fork is at `otsA`**, column 1, carried by 89% of chromosomes. Columns 1 to 23 also carry a second branch of 23 families, from `araH` to `fliA`, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, in 11% of chromosomes, all persistent. The most carried families there run from `otsA` through the `flh` and `che` genes to `torY`: `flhD` in 84%, `motA` in 87%, `cheY` in 87%, `flhB` in 86%. The model names 30 to 99.6% of calls across these columns, fewest at column 10, `tap`, named 30%.

**Hesitation peaks in the middle.** Column 34, `yebB`, is the most hesitant at 0.73 bits, in a region of plasticity in 15% of calls; column 24, `torZ`, follows at 0.66 bits, 3%; column 35, `yobI`, at 0.62 bits, 14%. Columns 26 to 31 carry a second branch of 6 families, `fliS` to `yedF`, in 10 to 11% of chromosomes, all persistent. No column has most of its calls in a region of plasticity.

**The long variable tail runs from `yebC` to `yobD`**, columns 32 to 78, in 70 to 83% of chromosomes, all persistent, from `ruvC` and `znuB` to `mntP`. The window ends at column 79, `manZ`, a fork carried by 59%, with `manY` at 31% and `manX` at 15%. Across the whole window the model names 93% of genes at 0.34 bits; inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 2.27 against 0.17 bits, and names fewer genes, 49% against 97%.

label: otsB
facts:
WINDOW: the otsB window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor otsB, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,832 to 1,911 from dnaA. Read in 533 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying otsB once); 42,640 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 93% of genes, 0.34 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 37,040 calls, named 99%, 0.14 bits; shell 4,872 calls, named 57%, 1.40 bits; cloud 728 calls, named 17%, 3.30 bits. Outside an RGP 39,222 calls, named 97%, 0.17 bits; inside an RGP 3,418 calls, named 49%, 2.27 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 30 fork, 49 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (2.27 against 0.17 bits) and names fewer genes (49% against 97%); 3,418 of the 42,640 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 34 (yebB) 0.73 bits, RGP 15%; column 24 (torZ) 0.66 bits, RGP 3%; column 35 (yobI) 0.62 bits, RGP 14%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 0-15%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: otsB. named 99.8%; 0.11 bits.
2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 0-15%. named 30-99.6% (mean 93%), fewest named at column 10, named 30%; most hesitant at column 34, 0.73 bits.
